_note: GST rule pack (I5): where a supply is taxed (IGST Act ss. 7–12). The engine reads the decide table; the cases table says which address the place of supply follows.

entries.rule: Supplier and place of supply in the same State or UT: CGST + SGST/UTGST, each at half the rate. Different States: IGST at the full rate.

explain.en: Supplier and place of supply in the same State or UT: CGST plus SGST/UTGST, each at half the rate. Different States: IGST at the full rate.
explain.hi-Latn: Dukaan aur supply ek hi State/UT mein: CGST + SGST/UTGST aadha-aadha. Alag State: poora IGST.

explain.en: To a registered customer: the customer's State. Goods to an unregistered customer: where they are delivered. Services to an unregistered customer: the supplier's State, unless the service is tied to a property or an event, when it is that place.
explain.hi-Latn: Registered customer: customer ka State. Bina-GST customer ko saaman: jahan deliver hua. Bina-GST customer ko service: aapka State, par property ya event se judi service ho to woh jagah.
